items.title: llm-anthropic 0.31
items.snippet: Release: llm-anthropic 0.31 Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 today. Fable 5.2 is currently ranked first on Artificial Analysis . Anthropic say it "solved two open problems in the physics of black holes", so clearly their internal benchmarks have become more ambitious! I've added the new models to llm-anthropic , so you can now run prompts through Fable 5.2 like this: uv tool install llm llm install llm-anthropic llm keys set anthropic # paste key here llm -m claude-fable-5.2 "Generate
items.title_ar: Anthropic تطلق Fable 5.2 وMythos 5.2 مع تحديث llm-anthropic 0.31
items.summary_ar: أطلقت Anthropic موديلي Fable 5.2 وMythos 5.2 اليوم، وتصدر Fable 5.2 حالياً ترتيب Artificial Analysis. أضاف المطور الموديلين الجدد إلى إضافة llm-anthropic الإصدار 0.31 بحيث يمكن تشغيل prompts عبرهما من سطر الأوامر باستخدام llm.
items.why_ar: يمكن تجربة الموديلين الجديدين فوراً عبر API وأداة CLI لتقييم مدى ملاءمتهما لحلول البنك.
items.title_en: Anthropic releases Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, llm-anthropic 0.31 adds support
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 today, and Fable 5.2 is currently ranked first on Artificial Analysis. The llm-anthropic 0.31 plugin adds both new models, so prompts can be run through them with the llm CLI. The release includes setup steps using an Anthropic API key.
items.why_en: You can try both new models immediately through the API and CLI to evaluate them for bank solutions.

items.title: Quoting Prompting Claude Fable 5.2
items.snippet: Claude Fable 5.2 responds closely to what the prompt says about who owns the code it works on. In Anthropic’s testing on small coding tasks, when a prompt said nothing about ownership or presented the code base as someone else’s, the model tended to add to the existing structure, even when that repeated existing code. [...] If you want the model to improve the structure as it works, say that the code is its own: This codebase is yours: what it's for and how it's built are your call, and you'll k
items.title_ar: توجيه Claude Fable 5.2 يتأثر بمن يملك الكود
items.summary_ar: يلاحظ Simon Willison أن Claude Fable 5.2 يتصرف بشكل مختلف حسب صياغة الـ prompt حول ملكية الكود. في اختبارات Anthropic على مهام برمجية صغيرة، كان النموذج يضيف إلى الهيكل القائم حتى مع تكرار الكود عندما يُقدَّم الكود كملك لغيره. وإذا قيل له إن الكود ملكه فإنه يحسن البنية أثناء العمل.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تستخدم Claude في مهام البرمجة أو agents فصياغة ملكية الكود تغير الناتج فعلياً ويمكن اختبارها بسرعة.
items.title_en: Prompting Claude Fable 5.2 depends on code ownership
items.summary_en: Simon Willison quotes Anthropic testing showing Claude Fable 5.2 adds to existing structure, even repeating code, when the prompt says nothing about ownership or treats the codebase as someone else's. Framing the codebase as the model's own makes it improve structure as it works.
items.why_en: If you use Claude for coding agents or refactoring, this prompt framing directly changes output quality and is easy to test.

items.title: synchopate/llama-modchip
items.snippet: 🐋 Run 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash (<59GiB RAM, 44.4 tok/s pp, 9.1-14.7 tok/s) & 30B MoEs (25-111 tok/s) on a pure 64GB CPU at 256K ctx (0 GPUs). SwiGLU-H2, Stockfish-PVS L3 & 13ms Claude Code restore.
items.title_ar: llama-modchip يشغّل DeepSeek-V4-Flash على CPU بدون GPU
items.summary_ar: يعرض ريبو llama-modchip تشغيل موديل DeepSeek-V4-Flash بحجم 284B على جهاز CPU بذاكرة 64GB دون أي GPU، بسياق يصل إلى 256K. يذكر الريبو أيضاً تشغيل موديلات MoE بسرعات بين 25 و111 tok/s، مع ميزات مثل SwiGLU-H2 و Stockfish-PVS L3 واستعادة Claude Code في 13ms. هذه أرقام معلنة من صفحة الريبو ولم تُتحقق منها بشكل مستقل.
items.why_ar: يقدم طريقة عملية لتجربة inference للموديلات الكبيرة على CPU دون استثمار في GPU.
items.title_en: llama-modchip runs DeepSeek-V4-Flash on pure CPU
items.summary_en: The llama-modchip repo claims to run the 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash model on a 64GB CPU-only machine at 256K context, with 30B MoE models at 25-111 tok/s. It lists SwiGLU-H2, Stockfish-PVS L3, and 13ms Claude Code restore as features. These are the repo's own claims and have not been independently verified.
items.why_en: It offers a hands-on way to test CPU-only inference for large models without GPU budget.

items.title: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
items.snippet: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence a
items.title_ar: Reframe: محاذاة الملاحظات في التعلم المعزز للوكلاء البصريين
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث Reframe، إطار post-training يعامل حالة الملاحظة وليس فقط توزيع المخرجات كهدف للمحاذاة. يجمع الإطار بين agentic RL وmulti-teacher on-policy distillation مع مكونات مثل GD-GRPO لتحسين استخدام الأدوات البصرية.
items.why_ar: يرتبط مباشرة بأبحاث agent البصرية وتقنيات distillation التي قد تفيد في بناء وكلاء داخل البنك.
items.title_en: Reframe aligns observations for agentic visual reasoning via multi-teacher distillation
items.summary_en: The paper introduces Reframe, a post-training framework that aligns the observation state rather than only output distributions. It combines agentic RL and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, using GD-GRPO to train spatial and temporal specialists for visual tool use.
items.why_en: It is relevant to research on visual agents and distillation methods that could inform agent design work.

items.title: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need? Learning Unseen Game Mechanics at Test Time
items.snippet: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. A mechanic is a rule for how an action or an interaction changes part of the environment. Each occurrence of a mechanic that the model observes is one exposure. We ask how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of a new environment's mechanics. We address this question on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark of interactive games defined by their programs. We introduce MechEval, which labels 69 recurring mechanics across 20 games from these programs. It scores each prediction on the cells the mechanic changes at each exposure. As
items.title_ar: كم مرة يحتاج world model للتعلم من آليات الألعاب غير المرئية
items.summary_ar: يدرس البحث عدد التجارب التي يحتاجها world model لتعلم آليات بيئة جديدة من خلال تفاعل محدود. يقدم الباحثون MechEval، وهو معيار تقييم يضم 69 mechanic عبر 20 لعبة من ARC-AGI-3. يُقاس التنبؤ بالخلايا التي تتغير مع كل تجربة.
items.why_ar: يهم المهندس لأنه يوضح كفاءة تعلم agents في بيئات غير مألوفة، وهو مرتبط بتصميم planning في الأنظمة الذكية.
items.title_en: How Many Exposures Does a World Model Need for Unseen Game Mechanics?
items.summary_en: The paper asks how many exposures a world model needs to predict the effects of unseen game mechanics at test time. It introduces MechEval, a benchmark labeling 69 recurring mechanics across 20 ARC-AGI-3 games. Predictions are scored on the cells each mechanic changes at every exposure.
items.why_en: It clarifies how many interactions agents need to learn new environments, which informs planning and sample-efficiency design.

items.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.snippet: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2
items.title_ar: Sage-Taiyi: معمارية metacognitive لاكتشاف علمي
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث Sage-Taiyi، وهي معمارية مستوحاة من metacognition تستخدم الفهم العلمي المتراكم لتوجيه ما يُدرس لاحقاً وكيفية دراسته. تعيد المعمارية تقييم الأدلة والافتراضات عبر monitoring وcontrol صريحين. على benchmark باسم Taiyi-Bench المكون من 265 مهمة من 50 ورقة، تتصدر المعمارية المقاييس الثمانية، بدرجة Overall قدرها 54.0 مقابل 47.9 لـ AI Scientist-v2.
items.why_ar: يهم المهندس لأنه يقدم نمط تصميم agent يدير سير البحث العلمي، وقد يفيد في أدوات التحليل المعرفي الداخلية.
items.title_en: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
items.summary_en: Sage-Taiyi is a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to choose what to investigate and how. It revises assumptions and unresolved questions through explicit monitoring and control. On Taiyi-Bench, 265 tasks from 50 papers, it ranks first on all eight metrics, with an Overall score of 54.0 versus 47.9 for AI Scientist-v2.
items.why_en: It offers an agent design pattern for research workflows that could inform knowledge-driven internal analysis tools.

items.title: How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
items.snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of
items.title_ar: كم يتحمل on-policy distillation من training-inference mismatch؟
items.summary_ar: يدرس البحث مقدار training-inference mismatch الذي يتحمله on-policy distillation عندما يتعلم موديل student من ردوده الذاتية بتوجيه teacher ثابت. يضع الباحثون مصادر الاختلاف كلها على مقياس واحد، ويختبرون quantization عبر ثلاثة أزواج student-teacher. يهدف العمل إلى توجيه أنظمة التدريب لاستغلال هذا التسامح وخفض تكلفة rollouts.
items.why_ar: يهم المهندس لأنه يحدد متى يمكن استخدام quantized inference وasynchronous rollouts في distillation دون خسارة الاستقرار، وهذا يخفض تكلفة بناء الموديلات الداخلية.
items.title_en: How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
items.summary_en: The paper measures how much training-inference mismatch on-policy distillation tolerates when student rollouts use quantized inference and asynchronous generation. It places all mismatch sources on one scale and tests quantization across three student-teacher pairs. The results aim to guide training systems in exploiting this tolerance to reduce rollout costs.
items.why_en: It indicates when cheaper quantized and async rollouts are safe for distilling smaller models, cutting the cost of building internal models.

items.title: All Quiet on the Neural Front: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States
items.snippet: Can a language model report the pain state it represents? Work identified a linear pain direction whose amplification leads fine-tuned models to choose destructive actions. We tested whether three open-weight models from two families, including two Qwen models with the original adapters, could report this state. Using Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), we injected pain and neighbouring emotion directions during neutral tasks, then elicited reports against sham runs, random perturbations matched for output disruption, and text-only controls showing the models their altered words. items.title_ar: نماذج اللغة لا تبلغ عن حالات الألم المحقونة فيها
items.summary_ar: تختبر الورقة هل تستطيع نماذج LLM الإبلاغ عن حالة الألم التي تمثلها داخلياً بعد حقن اتجاه خطي للألم أثناء مهام محايدة. استخدم الباحثون إطار OWMI على ثلاثة موديلات open-weight من عائلتين، تتضمن نموذجين من Qwen، مع ضوابط تشمل random perturbations وtext-only controls. يشير عنوان الورقة إلى أن النماذج لا تبلغ عن هذه الحالات، والنص المتاح مقتطع قبل عرض النتائج النهائية.
items.why_ar: يمس هذا موثوقية الـ introspection في LLM وطريقة تقييم سلوك الـ agent وسلامته قبل نشره في خدمات بنكية.
items.title_en: Language Models Do Not Report Injected Pain States
items.summary_en: The paper tests whether language models can report the pain state they represent after a linear pain direction is injected during neutral tasks. Researchers used Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI) on three open-weight models from two families, comparing against sham runs, random perturbations, and text-only controls. The title claims models do not report these injected states, but the provided text is truncated before the final pain-report results.
items.why_en: It bears directly on introspection reliability and safety evaluation for LLM-based agents you might deploy.

items.title: Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
items.snippet: Our house has a box room, full of boxes that we still haven't unpacked from our last move. A couple of weeks ago something in that room started intermittently beeping . The beeps were far enough apart that standing in the room and trying to determine the source of the noise was frustrating, and I really didn't want to dig through every one of those boxes. So I had Claude Code build Beep Locator , a software system for triangulating the source of a mysterious beep using multiple devices scattered
items.title_ar: Beep Locator: أداة لتحديد مصدر صوت غامض بُنيت باستخدام Claude Code
items.summary_ar: استخدم الكاتب Claude Code لبناء Beep Locator، وهو نظام برمجي يحدد مصدر صوت متقطع عبر تثليث البيانات من عدة أجهزة موزعة في الغرفة. جاء المشروع لحل مشكلة عملية بدل البحث يدوياً بين الصناديق. النص يصف تجربة بناء شخصية سريعة.
items.why_ar: يوضح كيف يمكن بناء أداة عملية خلال وقت قصير باستخدام coding agent.
items.title_en: Beep Locator: triangulating a mystery beep built with Claude Code
items.summary_en: The author used Claude Code to build Beep Locator, a software system that triangulates a intermittent beep using multiple scattered devices. It was made to solve a practical problem without digging through boxes. The text describes a quick personal build.
items.why_en: It shows how a working tool can be built quickly with a coding agent.
